scientific_integrity: The all-size result is analytically proved by Fourier projection, exact two-vector spectral minimax optimization, and exhaustive arithmetic angle/length inequalities; finite checker tests are supplementary and do not certify universal truth or priority.
scientific_limitations: The theorem optimizes only the first-order gain as the added total chord conductance tends to zero on an unweighted undirected cycle with equal unit conductance prices. No claim is made about exact finite-budget optimality, directed graphs, weighted baseline cycles, or independent publication-priority certification.
title: Optimal two-chord infinitesimal acceleration of cycle consensus
